items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: he said, well, when are you going to come back and work for me... they gave me the job leading the band

ctx.x: And I come back and I worked with Don Redman in that era somewhere. Then finally one day I was down back of the Apollo Theater and I ran into Charlie Buchanan who had the Savoy. And he said, well, when are you going to come back and work for me. I said, well, I don't want to come back up there but if you want me to do something get me the job conducting for Ella. So he did. He said, meet me down to the office tomorrow. And I went down and (unintelligible) and talked to them and they gave me the job leading the…
Well, did she stand in front of the band?
